places.name: Parque José Martí & Terry Theater
places.ai_summary: Parque José Martí is the central square of Cienfuegos, surrounded by historic buildings like the Terry Theater, known for its cultural significance.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the day to explore the architecture.

places.place_tip: Take a guided tour to learn about the history and architecture.

places.name: Cathedral of the Immaculate Conception
places.ai_summary: The Cathedral of the Immaculate Conception is a historic church in Cienfuegos, featuring stunning stained glass windows and neoclassical architecture.

opening_hours.notes: Hours may vary during religious services.

places.place_tip: Admire the intricate stained glass windows and serene atmosphere.
places.address: Cathedral of the Immaculate Conception, Cienfuegos, Cuba

places.name: Palacio de Valle
places.ai_summary: Palacio de Valle is an architectural gem in Cienfuegos, blending Gothic, Moorish, and Venetian styles, and offering panoramic rooftop views.

opening_hours.notes: Guided tours are available for an additional fee.

places.place_tip: Visit the rooftop for stunning views of the bay.

attribution.title: Cienfuegos maurische Villa
attribution.author: Dieter Mueller, dino1948
attribution.description: Mansion in the Moorish Revival architecture style, in Cienfuegos, central Cuba.

places.name: Malecón de Cienfuegos
places.ai_summary: The Malecón de Cienfuegos is a scenic seaside promenade, perfect for a leisurely walk with views of the bay and local life.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during sunset for a magical experience.

places.place_tip: Bring a camera to capture the stunning views of the bay.

attribution.title: Monumento a Martí en el Centro Cívico, Habana. Concentración Campesina. 1959. - panoramio

attribution.description: Monumento a Martí en el Centro Cívico, Habana. Concentración Campesina. 1959.

places.name: Punta Gorda Peninsula
places.ai_summary: Punta Gorda Peninsula is a picturesque area in Cienfuegos, known for its beautiful beaches, historic homes, and the iconic Palacio de Valle.

opening_hours.notes: Explore the area by foot or bike for the best experience.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the sunset views from the peninsula.

attribution.author: https://www.flickr.com/photos/uira/
attribution.description: Dominican Republic Marina of Cap Cana, Punta Cana.

places.name: Castillo de Jagua
places.ai_summary: Castillo de Jagua is a historic fortress in Cienfuegos, offering insights into the area's colonial past and stunning views of the bay.

opening_hours.notes: Access by ferry; check schedule in advance.

places.place_tip: Explore the museum inside for a deeper understanding of the history.

places.name: Botanical Garden of Cienfuegos
places.ai_summary: The Botanical Garden of Cienfuegos is a lush, tropical garden showcasing Cuba's diverse flora, with several themed sections and a tranquil atmosphere.

opening_hours.notes: Guided tours available; check schedule.

places.place_tip: Visit the orchid garden and the palm tree collection.
places.address: Botanical Garden of Cienfuegos, Cienfuegos, Cuba

places.name: Museo Provincial
places.ai_summary: Museo Provincial is a key cultural institution in Cienfuegos, housed in a neoclassical building, featuring exhibits on the city's history, art, and culture.

opening_hours.notes: Check for special exhibitions and events.

places.place_tip: Join a guided tour for detailed insights into the exhibits.

attribution.title: Camilo Cienfuegos
attribution.author: Unknown author.
attribution.description: Camilo Cienfuegos — in Cuba in the 1950s.

places.name: Arco de Triunfo
places.ai_summary: The Arco de Triunfo in Cienfuegos is a prominent archway commemorating the city's heroes, offering a great photo opportunity and historical insights.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning or late afternoon for photos.

places.place_tip: Combine your visit with a stroll in Parque José Martí.

places.name: Ferried Boat to Castillo View
places.ai_summary: The ferried boat ride to Castillo de Jagua offers a unique perspective of the fortress and the bay, combined with a pleasant boat trip.

opening_hours.notes: Check the ferry schedule in advance.

places.place_tip: Sit on the upper deck for the best views during the ride.

places.name: La Unión Hotel Rooftop
places.ai_summary: The rooftop of La Unión Hotel offers a panoramic view of Cienfuegos, ideal for sunset watching and enjoying a drink.

opening_hours.notes: Reservations recommended for sunset views.

places.place_tip: Try the local cocktails while enjoying the view.

places.name: Marina & Yacht Club
places.ai_summary: The Marina & Yacht Club in Cienfuegos is a hub for boating enthusiasts, offering boat rentals, sailing lessons, and a restaurant with a view.

opening_hours.notes: Check for sailing tour availability.

places.place_tip: Consider a sailing lesson for a unique experience.

places.name: Guanaroca Lagoon (Flamingos)
places.ai_summary: Guanaroca Lagoon is a natural reserve near Cienfuegos, famous for its flamingo population and other bird species, best explored by boat.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited with a guided boat tour.

places.place_tip: Bring binoculars for bird watching.

places.name: Boulevard San Fernando
places.ai_summary: Boulevard San Fernando is a vibrant street in Cienfuegos, lined with shops, restaurants, and cultural attractions, perfect for a leisurely stroll.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the evening for dining and entertainment.

places.place_tip: Try the local cuisine at one of the boulevard restaurants.

places.name: Palacio Ferrer Viewpoint
places.ai_summary: The Palacio Ferrer Viewpoint offers a unique architectural style and a great vantage point to view the city and the bay.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during sunset.

places.place_tip: Combine with a visit to the Palacio de Valle for a complete experience.

places.name: Rancho Luna Beach
places.ai_summary: Rancho Luna Beach is a popular beach near Cienfuegos, known for its clear waters, water sports, and vibrant marine life.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning for a quiet experience.

places.place_tip: Bring snorkeling gear to explore the underwater life.

attribution.description: Booking photo of Joaquín "El Chapo" Guzmán after he arrived in the United States following his extradition from Mexico in 2017.

places.name: Dolphinarium Cienfuegos
places.ai_summary: Dolphinarium Cienfuegos is a marine park offering interactive experiences with dolphins, sea lions, and other marine animals.

opening_hours.notes: Book in advance for interactive sessions.

places.place_tip: Wear comfortable clothes and shoes for the interactive sessions.

places.name: Jagua Bay Scenic Drive
places.ai_summary: The Jagua Bay Scenic Drive is a beautiful coastal road in Cienfuegos, offering stunning views of the bay, cliffs, and lush vegetation.

opening_hours.notes: Drive slowly to enjoy the views and take photos.

places.place_tip: Stop at viewpoints along the way for the best photos.
places.address: Jagua Bay Scenic Drive, Cienfuegos, Cuba

places.name: Cienfuegos Prado Promenade
places.ai_summary: The Cienfuegos Prado Promenade is a lively street in the city center, ideal for a leisurely walk, dining, and enjoying local culture.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the evening for a vibrant atmosphere.

places.place_tip: Enjoy live music and street performances if available.

places.name: Sunset at Punta Gorda
places.ai_summary: The sunset at Punta Gorda is a breathtaking experience, where the sun dips below the horizon, casting vibrant colors over the bay.

opening_hours.notes: Arrive early to secure a good viewing spot.

places.place_tip: Bring a blanket and snacks for a relaxing sunset picnic.
